entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [iOS] Modal-Page crashes #31829
  • Rotating the screen causes a white line on top of the simulator when deploying ManualMaui Demo project on iOS 26. #31826
  • [.NET10] I9 - Scroll_Position - "KeepLastItemInView" does not keep the last item at the end of the displayed list when adding new items. #31825
  • [.NET 10] I2 - Vertical_list_for_ItemSpan_and_ItemSpacing - The page slows down when resizing the window #31824
  • IntelliSense stops working after replacing 2021 with global in MAUI XAML namespace #31822
  • [Windows] Boxview shadow is not aligned with boxview shape #31821
  • `Switch` is invisible on `PointOver` when theme has changed #31819
  • [Windows]MauiAsset LogicalName doesn't work #31818

Closed

  • [Android] Content is removed from page before animation during back navigation, when using NavigationPage #16518
  • [regression/7.0.49] Deep Link for Android with .Net Maui error - Error when navigate other page #15192
